scope: Compare a flat ten-period local PMActivationProfile against one nested PM-ROOT/PM-HALF profile repeating five nonoverlapping 12-hour disable/enable cycles; accept only observed SIMLOX 2017 CLI behavior, exact roundtrip and sealed native parity.

manual.rule: PMActivationProfile supports a profile referring to a subprofile; IQTY and IINT repeat that block without overlapping explicit LIMIT periods. ENPM=N prevents PM start while counters continue, and ENPM=Y re-enables local PM.

frozen_source_delta: Derive both arms from the accepted D13.var01 local CAL24 PMActivation input: seed1, one aircraft, three h8/h20/h32 missions and 60-hour horizon unchanged. Control.ENPM remains Y.
The flat arm uses PM-FLAT with ten explicit adjacent six-hour LIMIT rows alternating ENPM=N/Y from h0 to h60.

The nested arm uses PM-ROOT referencing PM-HALF at STIM0 with IQTY5/IINT12; PM-HALF defines two adjacent LIMIT rows, N h0-6 and Y h6-12. Both expand to the same time schedule. Only description, PMActivation.PRID and PMActivationProfile rows differ between arms.
acceptance_hypotheses: Both arms import and roundtrip exact authored populated cells with zero converter errors and usable SXOs; nested SPRID reference and repetition parameters remain intact.

Both arms generate the same physical PM and mission event sequence: the h24 due PM is disabled until h30 and works h30-31; a later PM works h55-56. Event and report equality must be checked from native output, not presumed from the schedule design.
The 120 half-hour System/Stock bins, PM starts/completions, six mission hours and terminal aircraft state reconcile.
gate: Publish only if nested and expanded flat sources yield identical native event logs and all non-description report cells, with clean conversion, exact authored roundtrip, sealed raw evidence, and independent read-only replay. Otherwise retain the immutable run as an excluded diagnostic and revise a new version. Do not infer an internal PM counter trace or general hierarchy law.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID 13340/session 1 identity, immutable run path, 60-second targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One seed, one aircraft, one PM, five repetitions of one two-period child profile; no other cycle, nested depth, overlap error, global ENPM comparison, GUI or cross-engine claim.
